The previously-curated 'LightningDamage' calc (flat 0 + 0.1x total AD + 0.2x AP) that lives under UdyrPassive.mSpellCalculations is not referenced by any other ability anywhere in the bin (no SourceObject cross-reference found), and no live tooltip text attributes any damage to the passive -- concluded to be orphaned/unused legacy BIN data, not a real live mechanic. Removed; P now correctly has no damage.
_noteQ: Wilding Claw base cast (un-Awakened) has TWO on-hit bonuses confirmed by wiki. (1) %maxHP physical component = BIN calc MaxHPOnHit1 (MaxHPOnHitBase DataValue 2/3/4/5/6/7/8% + bonus AD * MaxHPADRatio 0.035%-per-100-AD), matches wiki 'Bonus Physical Damage: 3/4/5/6/7/8% (+3.5% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health' applied per attack -- curated via hpPercentCalc, count 2 (wiki's separate 'Total Physical Damage' line, exactly double the per-attack line, confirms exactly 2 applications). (2) Flat on-hit component = BIN calc OnHitDamage (BaseDamage DataValue 0/6/12/18/24/30/36 + bonus AD*0.2 + bonus Health*OnHitBonusHPRatio), matches wiki 'Bonus Physical Damage On-Hit: 6/12/18/24/30/36 (+20% bonus AD) (+1-2% bonus health)', a separate 4s on-hit buff -- curated at count 1 (duration-based proc, no fixed hit cap cited). Both Physical, both direct Q hits (Q is a discrete cast that empowers subsequent autos, same pattern as Vayne Q). The AWAKEN recast's chained-lightning bonus (calcs Q2TotalOnHitHPDamage / EmpoweredLightningBonus) is NOT curated: EmpoweredLightningBonus's formula tree uses an unrecognized/hashed CalculationPart kind ({ee18a47b} with fields {0589a59c}/{0b65bc23}) not in FormulaInterpreter's supported kind list, and the mechanic itself chains to up to 3 other visible enemies (multi-target, outside this schema's single-target hit model) -- genuinely unresolvable, same category as XinZhao W's Thrust phase.

_noteR: Wingborne Storm base cast: StormDamage (StormBaseDamage DataValue + AP*0.35) is the blizzard's magic-damage-over-time calc, kept from the prior pass -- it references only fully-supported CalculationPart kinds (NamedDataValue + StatByCoefficient) and is the obviously-correct calc name for the ability, and wiki confirms it as a real continuously-ticking magic-damage zone the target can walk out of ('deals magic damage every 0.5 seconds ... while they remain within'). Curated conservatively at count 1 (one tick, not assuming the target stands in the full duration -- same escapable-zone honesty convention as Malzahar's Null Zone). Tagged Zone at the slot level. The AWAKEN recast's %maxHP-based storm variant (calc PercentHPBlast) and the minion-damage-scaling variant (DamageToMinions_Scaling) are NOT curated -- kept out, conservative, same precedent as Draven Q's axe-catch bonus: a real but secondary/more-complex recast-only phase, out of scope for this pass.
_noteQAwaken: Q AWAKENED TOGGLE (loop 479). Two things the older note said were blockers are no longer true. (1) EmpoweredLightningBonus/EmpoweredLightningBonusMax RESOLVE now (probed this loop at level 11 with 100 AP: 0.03 per strike, 0.18 for the six-strike total) - whatever hashed part kind blocked the loop-39 pass has since been implemented. Both match the live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Udyr, fetched 2026-08-21): per strike 1.5-3.18% (based on level) (+0.6% per 100 AP) of MAXIMUM health, six strikes per empowered attack, total per attack 9-19.06% (+3.6% per 100 AP). (2) The awakened state itself had no way to be stated; the Upgraded condition is that. Curated as a third hit at count 2, the same count as the base %maxHP line, because the six strikes ride EACH of Q1s two empowered attacks - EmpoweredLightningBonusMax is already the per-attack total, so count 2 is the pair of attacks, not the strikes. MAGIC, wiki-confirmed, unlike the physical base. The chain to up to three other visible enemies stays uncurated for the same reason as before: this schema models one target.
_noteRAwaken: R AWAKENED, DELIBERATELY NOT CURATED (loop 479). PercentHPBlast resolves cleanly (0.15 at level 11 / 100 AP) and matches the wikis awakened Wingborne Storm total of 8-14.71% (+3.5% per 100 AP) maximum health - but it is the total over the FULL 4-second duration, i.e. all eight ticks, while the base R above is deliberately curated at ONE tick (the escapable-zone convention this project uses for Malzahar W). Adding a full-duration awakened total on top of a one-tick base would make the toggle read as a ~10x jump that is an artifact of two different exposure assumptions, not of the awakening. There is no per-tick awakened calc in the BIN to pair with the base line. Left out until R migrates to the perSecondCalc/maxDurationSeconds shape, where both halves can share one exposure knob honestly. Q carries the awaken toggle in the meantime.
